title: Home Oxygen Therapy Equipment Catalogue — Portable Delivery, Accessories and Air Travel
content:
# Equipment Catalogue — Home Oxygen Therapy

The Home Oxygen Therapy system classes differ in how the portable unit delivers oxygen, which accessories come with it, and whether it may be carried on aircraft.

| System class | Portable unit delivers pulse dose | Conserving device furnished with portable cylinders or liquid | Home-fill cylinders furnished with the fill unit (count) | Batteries furnished with a portable concentrator (count) | Portable unit may be carried on aircraft |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Stationary Concentrator Oxygen (E1390) | no | no | 0 | 0 | no |
| Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) | no | yes | 0 | 0 | no |
| Concentrator with Home Fill System (E1390 + K0738) | no | no | 6 | 0 | no |
| Concentrator with Portable Oxygen Concentrator (E1390 + E1392) | yes | no | 0 | 2 | yes |
| Liquid Oxygen System (E0439 + E0434) | no | yes | 0 | 0 | no |
| High-Flow Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) | no | no | 0 | 0 | no |

## Catalogue notes

- The home-fill cylinder count is 0 for every class without a fill unit; the battery count is 0 for every class without a portable concentrator.
- A conserving device is listed for Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) and Liquid Oxygen System (E0439 + E0434). High-Flow Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) lists none, although it also carries portable cylinders.
- Concentrator with Portable Oxygen Concentrator (E1390 + E1392) is the only class whose portable unit delivers pulse dose and the only class whose portable unit may be carried on aircraft.

## Comparing two classes (illustration)

| | Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) | High-Flow Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) |
|---|---|---|
| Pulse dose | no | no |
| Conserving device | yes | no |
| Carried on aircraft | no | no |
